dimension_justifications.soundness: The formal definitions are plausible and several arithmetic identities check, but every empirical result supporting the central claims is explicitly source-reported/cannot-verify. Event semantics, analyzed-position inclusion, code, machine-readable results, registrations, checkpoint identity, and exact inputs are absent, so the central numerical conclusions cannot presently be validated.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is unusually candid about evidence tiers, composite intervention, sequential probes, post-treatment amendment, weak calibration, and unavailable artifacts. Definitions and limitations are generally clear, though the dense accumulation of source-reported diagnostics makes the actual independently supported result difficult to isolate.
dimension_justifications.contribution: Separating boundary-set reachability from event-dependent magnitude is a useful reporting principle, and the active-recorder case is potentially informative. However, the empirical contribution is narrow, wholly unauditable in this snapshot, lacks a dual-recorder comparison, and is not supported by a comprehensive closest-work audit.

paper_summary: The paper studies identity-lock periodicity measured through an active-block recorder in a blockwise LLaDA-style diffusion language model. Holding the model family, questions, canvas, decoding rule, temperature, and total NFE nominally fixed, it changes block length together with the required per-block step allocation. It reports that a min-max candidate selector follows the configured block length for L16/L64 main arms, a reused L32 development control, and sequential L24/L48 probes; a rank-sum ordering of the same profiles reportedly agrees. The manuscript carefully limits this to a recorder-relative descriptive result and recommends separating algebraic boundary reachability from conclusions requiring observed event magnitudes. All empirical quantities are nevertheless marked source-reported/cannot-verify because the submission lacks the underlying events, implementations, result arrays, registrations, and exact model/data artifacts.
strongest_verified_contribution: The strongest independently checkable contribution is the finite-domain measurement decomposition: candidate boundary sets are defined on adjacent-difference indices, and algebraic reachability is explicitly separated from event-dependent separation signs. The displayed NFE sums, boundary/interior cardinalities, minimum exact permutation probability, GPU-hour conversion, and reported main-arm event-row arithmetic are internally consistent under the implied decreasing-mask recorder convention. This verifies formal bookkeeping, not the empirical profiles or selector outcomes.
strengths: The manuscript explicitly labels empirical numbers SR/CV and does not present unavailable analyses as independently reproduced.

It correctly distinguishes same-profile rank-sum sensitivity from independent evidence, bootstrap selection stability from false-positive control, and a composite partition-plus-allocation intervention from a mechanism-isolating experiment.
Equation (1) defines lock time on a finite observation domain, while Equation (2) gives an explicit candidate grid, admissibility condition, extremum statistic, and tie rule.
The discussion of median discreteness is correct: integer lock times with an even sample can yield half-integral medians, differences, and separations, without forcing a bootstrap point mass.
Evidence is stratified into a reused development control, two main arms, two sequential probes, and a separate content bed; the paper does not portray these as five equivalent confirmations.

The displayed schedules all sum to NFE 48. The reported boundary/interior cardinalities match the finite domains, 330 seconds on eight GPUs equals approximately 0.73 GPU-hours, and the canvas-256 event-row counts are arithmetically consistent with the implied masked-position recording schedule.
All files listed in MANIFEST.json match their listed SHA-256 hashes. The PDF is anonymous, uses letter pages and embedded fonts, and keeps main text within nine pages before references/appendices.
The manuscript includes an AI-assistance disclosure and clearly marks Figure 1 as non-evidentiary and Figure 2 as data-derived but unreproducible from the package.
questions: Can the authors provide a reviewer-safe bundle containing deidentified event streams, executable analysis code, machine-readable result vectors, exact commands/configurations, seeds, logs, and output hashes sufficient to rebuild every empirical table and Figure 2?

What exactly is the recorder event schema: are step labels global NFE indices, block-local steps, or observation ordinals, and how are empty observation sets, unresolved/terminal positions, censoring, absent final values, and position-specific analyzed sets handled?
What checkpoint fingerprint, tokenizer/version, prompt template, GSM8K item IDs or blinded hashes, question ordering, precision settings, GPU type, and launcher configuration generated each arm?
Does the shared bootstrap index correspond to the same GSM8K item in every main arm, reused control, and sequential probe? Please provide a blinded item-pairing manifest.
Can the complete six-candidate separation and rank-sum vectors, replicate-level outputs, normalization, tie correction, and candidate-selection code for L24/L48 be released?

Can timestamped registration records and diffs establish that R0/R1 preceded main execution and R4 preceded each sequential probe, while clearly preserving the post-treatment status of the R3 scope withdrawal?
Which primary sources support every remaining substantive literature statement, beyond the three closest-work entries verified in citation_lock.json?
What image-generation model, prompt, settings, source asset hash, and generation record produced Figure 1?

This demonstrates an artifact absence; it does not demonstrate that the reported numbers are false.

A reviewer cannot validate number extraction, detect transcription errors, reproduce tables, or test implementation fidelity.

If raw events cannot be shared, provide a sufficiently detailed derived event table plus a trusted execution/reproduction report.

Compare complete machine-readable outputs and figure hashes, and independently recompute P*, separation signs, bootstrap fractions, bands, permutation summaries, and content statistics.
issues.evidence_needed: Reviewer-safe event data for every bed; analysis and plotting source; configurations; commands; dependency lock; seeds; logs; complete result vectors and replicate outputs; hashes tying all outputs to the PDF.

issues.location: PDF p.3, Section 2, “Identity-lock time and finite observation domain,” Equation (1); pp.8–9, “Event semantics” limitation; p.15, Appendix B, “Reported determinism claim”; method provenance A31-M1
issues.observed_evidence: The paper explicitly cannot determine whether s is a global function-evaluation index, block-local step, or per-position observation ordinal. It also lacks rules for empty observation sets, absent final values, censoring, terminal/unresolved positions, the source-defined analyzed sets A_r, and the exact median implementation.
issues.why_it_matters: These choices define the estimand. Different time coordinates or exclusions can change m(r), d(r), boundary extrema, half-step values, and therefore the selected period. The current equation is mathematically defined only after unresolved implementation choices are supplied.
issues.required_fix: Specify a versioned event-schema contract and reference implementation covering time coordinates, row ordering, predicted versus committed tokens, final-value construction, missingness/censoring, terminal cases, analyzed-set membership, and median convention.
issues.verification_test: Apply the implementation to published toy traces covering empty observations, last-step flips, terminal resolution, missing final values, even and odd analyzed-set sizes, and global versus local coordinates; verify exact expected lock times and then reproduce the real arm profiles.
issues.evidence_needed: Event-schema specification, recorder code, lock-time code, inclusion/exclusion counts by position and arm, median library/function/version, and unit tests with expected outputs.

Provide access to the checkpoint or a trusted escrowed execution route.
issues.verification_test: Resolve every arm index to the same blinded item where pairing is claimed; verify configuration hashes before launch; reproduce per-arm row counts and deterministic event digests from two clean executions.
issues.evidence_needed: Checkpoint fingerprint and access route, tokenizer and prompt artifacts, blinded data manifest, pairing manifest, seed, hardware/precision details, launcher/config files, and deterministic output hashes.

issues.location: PDF p.5, Section 2, “Registration and two-layer reachability”; p.8, registration-history limitation; p.12, Appendix A.2 and Table 8; experiment registry and evidence ID A31-R1
issues.observed_evidence: Only an opaque R0–R4 chronology is supplied. Trusted timestamps, registration records, searchable identifiers, and diffs are absent. The manuscript reports that the min-max estimator followed a failed development score and that the model-intrinsic branch was withdrawn after the main data were observed.
issues.why_it_matters: Without records, reviewers cannot separate genuinely pre-specified selection criteria and probe protocols from post-data choices. The acknowledged post-treatment scope change also limits confirmatory interpretation even if the chronology is accurate.
issues.required_fix: Provide blinded immutable registrations with trusted timestamps, hashes, complete protocols, amendment diffs, and an explicit classification of each analysis as development, pre-registered confirmatory, sequential, or exploratory.
issues.verification_test: Verify that registration hashes and trusted timestamps precede the corresponding raw-event creation times; diff every amendment; confirm that the executed configuration and candidate grid exactly match the applicable pre-run record.
issues.evidence_needed: Timestamped registration files, signed hashes, amendment diffs, execution timestamps, and a registration-to-run configuration crosswalk.

issues.location: PDF pp.5–8, Tables 2, 3, and 5 and Section 3.2; p.13, Appendix A.5 and Table 10
issues.observed_evidence: By the manuscript’s own account, bootstrap fractions measure sample stability rather than false-positive control; the source-reported original permutation gate flags 10/25 wrong candidates; corrected margins remain unadjusted diagnostics rather than full-selector calibration; L24 has pmargin=0.071 under the conditional construction; and L48 has one boundary locus. These limitations are candidly reported, and the corresponding empirical values themselves remain cannot-verify.
issues.why_it_matters: The evidence supports, at most, descriptive selections on the observed profiles. It does not establish a calibrated discovery procedure or strong robustness of the sequential probes, limiting both soundness and significance even if all numbers reproduce.
issues.required_fix: For detection language beyond descriptive reporting, pre-specify and run an arm-level structure-preserving null that calibrates the complete candidate-selection procedure with family-wise control. Add independent probe support with more than one selected boundary locus or narrow the contribution permanently to an illustrative case study.
issues.verification_test: On registered clean/null arms, estimate the complete selector’s family-wise false-selection rate and verify the target error bound; on fresh held-out probes, reproduce the selected period with multiple boundary loci and report all candidates and uncertainty.
issues.evidence_needed: A31-X5 or equivalent calibrated-null outputs, full candidate grids, fresh held-out probe data, multiplicity plan, and locus-level sensitivity results.

issues.location: PDF p.9, Section 5; p.15, Table 13; citation_lock.json

issues.why_it_matters: A narrow checked set cannot establish how distinct or significant the active-recorder diagnostic is relative to all relevant diffusion-decoding, instrumentation, periodicity, and probe-confounding work. This limits contribution assessment, though it is not evidence that a current citation is wrong.
issues.required_fix: Complete a primary-source metadata and local-support audit for every substantive citation and expand the closest-work comparison to the most relevant recorder/instrumentation and schedule-diagnostic methods while retaining bounded novelty language.
issues.verification_test: For every citation-bearing sentence, match the exact local proposition to a primary-source passage and verified metadata/version; remove, replace, or qualify any unsupported use. Confirm that closest-work claims do not exceed the audited corpus.
issues.evidence_needed: Complete citation lock with metadata, versions, support excerpts or precise locations, unsupported-use dispositions, and an expanded closest-work matrix.

ethics_concerns: No direct human-subject, privacy, safety, or misuse concern is evident from the frozen submission. The private checkpoint and opaque question identifiers are primarily reproducibility and provenance constraints. Compute accounting is source-reported and not independently auditable, but the paper does not make a sustainability claim.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by a fresh, isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control. It used only the frozen read-only submission snapshot, saw no prior reviews or author-side history, and did not use the internet. The manuscript itself discloses AI-assisted language editing, LaTeX refactoring, internal review, and an image-generated qualitative figure.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A complete reviewer-safe artifact bundle that cleanly reproduces every central table, full candidate vector, bootstrap/permutation output, and Figure 2 from hashed event inputs.
A versioned event-schema and identity-lock implementation with decisive unit tests for time coordinates, terminal cases, censoring, analyzed-set membership, and median convention.
Exact checkpoint, tokenizer, prompt, blinded data/pairing, seed, precision, launcher, and environment manifests supporting deterministic replay.
Timestamped immutable registrations and diffs that verify the claimed pre-run criteria and accurately classify the post-treatment amendment and sequential probes.
Complete probe and rank-sum candidate outputs confirming the reported argmaxes without omitted ties or stronger candidates.
A pre-specified, structure-preserving calibration of the complete selector and fresh non-nested probe evidence with multiple boundary loci.

A dual active/full-canvas recorder comparison on identical trajectories or a partition-by-allocation factorial, if the paper seeks stronger attribution than its current descriptive recorder-relative claim.
A complete primary-source citation audit and a broader closest-work matrix confirming the bounded novelty position.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: A clean rebuild that fails to reproduce any headline separation, argmax, bootstrap fraction, conditional margin, spectral value, or content statistic.
Event-schema disclosure showing that time coordinates, terminal exclusions, missingness, or median handling introduce schedule-dependent censoring or change P*.
A blinded pairing manifest showing that supposedly paired bootstrap indices do not correspond to matched questions across arms.
Registration timestamps or diffs showing that the selector, candidate grid, or probe analyses were finalized after the associated data were inspected.
Complete L24/L48 or rank-sum vectors revealing a tie, omitted stronger candidate, or different argmax.
Checkpoint or prompt fingerprints inconsistent across arms that are described as holding the model and decoding setup fixed.
Primary-source auditing showing that a central positioning or method claim is unsupported or materially mischaracterized.
review_limitations: The review was restricted to the frozen snapshot and could not inspect absent event streams, code, private model artifacts, registration records, or machine-readable results.
Internet access and external citation checking were prohibited; citation assessment is therefore limited to the included citation lock and manuscript bibliography.
All 17 PDF pages were inspected textually and visually, but scientific figure values could not be checked against source data because those data and generators are absent.

The arithmetic check of event-row totals assumes the decreasing masked-position recorder behavior implied by the schedules; the missing event schema prevents confirming that assumption against implementation.
